title: Dragon Diner Piano
description: A surreal scene viewed from inside a wooden structure, featuring a red-dressed skeleton playing a black grand piano with colorful mushrooms on its surface. Outside the open window, a vibrant fantasy landscape unfolds with a blue and pink dragon, a green dragon holding sheet music, a large windmill, a circus tent, and a wooden platform with a Celtic cross under a swirling pink and purple sky.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene inside a wooden room looking out an open window to a vibrant landscape. A skeleton in a red dress plays a black grand piano covered in colorful mushrooms. A long blue and pink dragon coils in the foreground with musical notes. Outside, a green dragon holds sheet music, a large windmill stands beside a red and yellow circus tent, and a wooden platform with an ornate Celtic cross sits in a field of pink and purple mushrooms. The sky is swirling pink and purple with dramatic clouds. Psychedelic, detailed digital painting with vibrant colors.
